dialogues.jp:
……杉並のヤツ。いったいどこで何をやってい
たんだか。
dialogues.en: ...That Suginami. Where the hell has he been?
dialogues.text: ...That Suginami. Where the hell has he been?

dialogues.jp: 昨日、アイツがくれたお土産……。
dialogues.en: I received another souvenir from him yesterday...
dialogues.text: I received another souvenir from him yesterday...

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ、このエッフェル塔の文鎮って」
dialogues.en: "What's with this paperweight Eiffel Tower..."
dialogues.text: "What's with this paperweight Eiffel Tower..."

dialogues.jp:
悪趣味な金ぴかメッキに、日本語で『ようこそ』
とか書かれてるし。
dialogues.en: A giant "Welcome!" in Japanese was written on it.
dialogues.text: A giant "Welcome!" in Japanese was written on it.

dialogues.jp: だいたい、エッフェル塔はフランスだろう。
dialogues.en: The Eiffel Tower is supposed to be in France...
dialogues.text: The Eiffel Tower is supposed to be in France...

dialogues.jp:
まあ、実際に、どこへ行って何をしていようと
俺は知ったこっちゃないけどな。
dialogues.en:
Well, I suppose it doesn't matter to me where on earth that
idiot is.
dialogues.text:
Well, I suppose it doesn't matter to me where on earth that
idiot is.

dialogues.jp:
仮に、あいつが真顔で『先週末、ちょっと火星
の親戚の家まで行ってきた』と言ってきても、
俺は真顔で『どうだった？』と答えるだろう。
dialogues.en:
He once told me with a straight face that "Last week, I
visited some relatives on Mars", and I replied "How was
it?".
dialogues.text:
He once told me with a straight face that "Last week, I
visited some relatives on Mars", and I replied "How was
it?".

dialogues.jp: ふと、机の上の携帯電話がブルブルと震えた。
dialogues.en: The cellphone in my pocket suddenly started vibrating.
dialogues.text: The cellphone in my pocket suddenly started vibrating.

dialogues.jp: 「メール？　杉並からか」
dialogues.en: "Mail? ...It's from Suginami."
dialogues.text: "Mail? ...It's from Suginami."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、携帯を手にとって、メールを開く。
dialogues.en: Pressing a few buttons on the cellphone, I opened the mail.
dialogues.text: Pressing a few buttons on the cellphone, I opened the mail.

dialogues.jp:
「ナニナニ……、実はもうひとつみやげがある。
　お前も喜ぶだろう。今すぐ公園まで来い……
　だと？」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, hm... "I in fact have one more souvenir to give you.
You'd be delighted with it. So come to the park right
now"...eh?"
dialogues.text:
"Hm, hm... "I in fact have one more souvenir to give you.
You'd be delighted with it. So come to the park right
now"...eh?"

dialogues.jp:
くだらん。こんな夜中に、わざわざメイドイン
アジアのイギリスみやげをもらいにいくことは
ない。
dialogues.en:
Like hell. I'm not going to go out in the middle of the
night to receive some souvenir of England with "Made In
Asia" on it.
dialogues.text:
Like hell. I'm not going to go out in the middle of the
night to receive some souvenir of England with "Made In
Asia" on it.

dialogues.jp:
メールフォルダを閉じようとしたら、もう一通
着信があった。
dialogues.en:
Just as I was about to close the mail folder, another one
arrived.
dialogues.text:
Just as I was about to close the mail folder, another one
arrived.

dialogues.jp:
「なにィ？　追伸──来ないとお前は一生後悔
　するぞ、だと？」
dialogues.en:
"Now what? "P.S: If you don't come, you'd regret it for the
rest of your life"... oh really?"
dialogues.text:
"Now what? "P.S: If you don't come, you'd regret it for the
rest of your life"... oh really?"

dialogues.jp:
バカバカしいとは思いつつも、釈然としない思
いが、胸の内をぐるぐると回る。
dialogues.en:
That's ridiculous... using such grandoise words almost made
my heart stop.
dialogues.text:
That's ridiculous... using such grandoise words almost made
my heart stop.

dialogues.jp: 「ちっ、杉並のヤツめ……」
dialogues.en: "Grr, that Suginami..."
dialogues.text: "Grr, that Suginami..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、立ち上がり、携帯をポケットに突っ込む。
dialogues.en: I stood up, and returned the cellphone to my pocket.
dialogues.text: I stood up, and returned the cellphone to my pocket.

dialogues.jp:
こうなってしまっては、あいつの思惑通り、呪
いにかかったも同然なのだが、どうにもじっと
はしていられない。
dialogues.en:
Looks like I'm going to just go along with his expectations
again...
dialogues.text:
Looks like I'm going to just go along with his expectations
again...

dialogues.jp: 「なにかあってからでは、遅いからな」
dialogues.en: "I'd walk slowly, it'd be better if I'm late."
dialogues.text: "I'd walk slowly, it'd be better if I'm late."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、自分でそう言い聞かせながら、家を出る。
dialogues.en: Talking to myself in bitternress, I headed out of the house.
dialogues.text: Talking to myself in bitternress, I headed out of the house.

dialogues.jp:
もうひとつのみやげだと？　いったいなんだと
言うんだ。
dialogues.en: Another souvenir? What does he want with me about it.
dialogues.text: Another souvenir? What does he want with me about it.

dialogues.jp:
行かないと、一生後悔するだと？　陳腐なセリ
フ使いやがって。
dialogues.en:
If I don't come, I'd regret it for the rest of my life?
That's old hat.
dialogues.text:
If I don't come, I'd regret it for the rest of my life?
That's old hat.

dialogues.jp: 「──まさか、な」
dialogues.en: "--Or maybe..."
dialogues.text: "--Or maybe..."

dialogues.jp: わざわざこんな夜中に俺を呼び出すやり方。
dialogues.en: Calling me out specially, at this time of the night.
dialogues.text: Calling me out specially, at this time of the night.

dialogues.jp: 杉並にしては、ちょっとスマートではない。
dialogues.en: He may be an idiot, but he's not dumb.
dialogues.text: He may be an idiot, but he's not dumb.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、気を取り直して、夜の帳の中、杉並に会
いに出かけるのだった。
dialogues.en:
Pulling myself together, I headed out into the curtain of
darkness, preparing to meet Suginami.
dialogues.text:
Pulling myself together, I headed out into the curtain of
darkness, preparing to meet Suginami.

dialogues.jp: ◆杉並の思惑◆
dialogues.en: ◆Suginami's Expectations◆
dialogues.text: ◆Suginami's Expectations◆

dialogues.jp: なぜか、夜中に杉並が俺を呼び出す。
dialogues.en:
For some reason, Suginami called me out in the middle of the
night.
dialogues.text:
For some reason, Suginami called me out in the middle of the
night.

dialogues.jp:
メールで呼び出すという、なにやら思惑ありげ
な行動に、俺は不信感を抱きつつも、ただごと
ではない気がして、出かけるのだった。
dialogues.en:
I had a bad feeling with whatever he wanted me for, but I
headed out as per his expectations anyway.
dialogues.text:
I had a bad feeling with whatever he wanted me for, but I
headed out as per his expectations anyway.

dialogues.jp: いったい、何を考えているんだ、あの男は。
dialogues.en: What on earth is that guy thinking...
dialogues.text: What on earth is that guy thinking...
